instruction: boltons.jsonutils.JSONLIterator can loop forever. When the starting position given by rel_seek lands inside the last line of a file that has no trailing newline, aligning to the next line never reaches a newline and keeps reading empty strings at end of file; it should stop and simply yield nothing more. A negative rel_seek is also normalized wrongly (-0.3 is treated as 1.3 instead of 0.7), which lands past the end of the file and hits the same loop; rel_seek=-0.5 should iterate the last half of the file as documented. Fix both and add tests.
